chicago-building-permits.collection_scope: Chicago new construction, renovation/alteration and Express Electrical Work permits; 30-day issue window plus 2-day modification overlap; scope, full address, parcel, application start, permit milestone and named party roles retained.
chicago-building-permits.coverage_limitation: Chicago status monitoring uses the official Socrata :updated_at row timestamp with a two-day overlap. Longer outages can miss changes; a dataset-wide replacement may exceed the bounded row limit and will fail visibly. Express Electrical Work includes small and residential work; inclusion in collection does not guarantee Signal admission. No dedicated procurement or commissioning coverage.

georgia-air-draft-title-v.collection_scope: Georgia EPD current draft Title V, SIP and synthetic-minor listing; narratives and draft permits including bounded generator schedule excerpts and draft front-page facility identity; application links retained when present.
georgia-air-draft-title-v.coverage_limitation: Not a complete air-application registry. Current application-link fields are empty; full applications may require agency request. Public notices are references only. At most 24 generator excerpts per PDF, 8 general pages; bounds and omitted excerpt counts are retained. Installed standby ratings are not rental demand.
